{{Quote|Mother? Father?''"<br />"''Shae&hellip; child&hellip;|Shae Koda's vision of her mother and father|<ref name="DOTJ 4" />}}
The '''father''' of [[Shae Koda]] was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was a member of the [[Je'daii Order]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. Lightly-skinned with [[Color/Legends|orange]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and a green triangle [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoo]] on his forehead, he and his [[Shae Koda's mother|wife]] were of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomiri]] descent, and had a daughter named Shae Koda sometime before the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[25,805 BBY]], when the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Despot Queen]] [[Hadiya]] attempted to conquer the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]] in the [[Despot War]]. Koda's father and mother fought the [[Despot Army]] on Tython, but both were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Hadiya personally at the gates of [[Kaleth]], the [[Je'daii Temples|Temple]] of Knowledge.<ref name="DOTJ 4" />

Though the Despot War ended with a Je'daii victory, Koda grew up an orphan and resented her parents for abandoning her. In [[25,793 BBY]], while in the [[Rift]]&mdash;a ravine on Tython saturated with the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]&mdash;Koda encountered [[Force vision/Legends|visions]] of her parents and attacked them in rage.<ref name="DOTJ 4" /> In [[25,792 BBY]], Koda's parents appeared in a vision to her in the depths of the [[Chasm]] on Tython.<ref name="DOTJ 15">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force War 5|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force War'' 5]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Shae Koda's father was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi 0]]'', a prequel issue for the [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi]]'', and he first appeared in a vision in the [[2012]] comic book [[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 4|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 4]];<ref name="DOTJ 4" /> her parents were also mentioned in the [[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 2|sixth issue]] of the series.<ref name="DOTJ 6">[[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 2|''Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan'' 2]]</ref>
